propositions: Inbound link ADD records that fail due to closed source, redundant ancestry, or cycle detection are re-emitted identically on every reconciler pass because failed links never land a LINK event in the binding store
The applier's warn-and-continue exception handling has no durable memory of permanently impossible link attempts, causing 19+ doomed rebar.link writes per pass indefinitely

A durable record keyed on source|target|relation with a structural digest of deciding inputs (endpoint status, parent chain, dependencies) allows the applier to skip known-impossible links until their deciding inputs change
Cycle detection requires invalidation on changes to intermediate tickets in the transitive graph, not only endpoint changes, to avoid under-invalidating and suppressing now-possible links
The impossible_links.json store must be committed to the tickets branch by the binding snapshot process so records survive process restarts and CI checkouts between passes
